overview: Embark on a 5-day journey through the natural and religious wonders of Sinai, exploring iconic sites like Mount Sinai and Ras Mohammed. This itinerary balances cultural experiences with serene natural landscapes, ensuring a memorable adventure.

stops.name: SOHO Square
stops.description: Upscale entertainment area with a musical fountain and ice rink.
stops.address: SOHO Square, أول شرم الشيخ، محافظة جنوب سيناء 46628, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Burning Bush
stops.description: The specific plant species mentioned in the Bible, located in the Monastery.
stops.address: HX4G+4QV, Saint Catherine, South Sinai Governorate 8730062, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Old Market
stops.description: Traditional bazaar perfect for souvenirs and local food.
stops.address: Entrance El-Souk, Sharm El Sheikh 2, South Sinai Governorate 8761130, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Farsha Mountain Lounge
stops.description: Iconic clifftop lounge with a bohemian vibe and sea views.
stops.address: هضبة ام السيد، Sharm El Sheikh 1, South Sinai Governorate 46619, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Genena City
stops.description: A huge shopping and entertainment mall on top of a hill in Naama Bay.
stops.address: W859+6W4 جنينه سيتى، Sharm El Sheikh 1, South Sinai Governorate 8763011, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Taba Heights
stops.description: Luxury resort town featuring golf courses and salt caves.
stops.address: Heights, Nuweiba, South Sinai Governorate 8785202, Egypt

tips: Start your days early to make the most of the cooler morning temperatures, especially when hiking.
Stay hydrated and carry snacks while exploring the natural sites.
Respect local customs, especially when visiting religious sites.
Consider local transportation options for easier access between sites.
Engage with local guides for deeper insights into the history and significance of each location.
summary: Enjoy your exploration of Sinai's rich tapestry of nature and spirituality!
